prompt: This command fails with 'class not found'. Why?
choices: Hello.class was not generated by javac
The class is in the com.example package — it must be run as 'java com.example.Hello' from the project root
com/example is not a valid directory structure
explanation: When a class is in a package, you must supply the fully-qualified name: java com.example.Hello. Running from the project root ensures the com/example directory structure is on the classpath. Running just 'java Hello' only works for classes in the default (unnamed) package.
